individual-data-points.explanation: Panel A is a spatial heatmap overlay showing per-spot values across tissue, not an averaged summary plot requiring individual points.

error-bars-defined.explanation: Spatial heatmap of individual spot values, no error bars or summary statistics are displayed.

individual-data-points.explanation: Box plots in panel B have individual data points (dots) overlaid for each sample.

error-bars-defined.from_the_caption: The box plots represent the distribution of values for each group, extending from the 25th percentile to the 75th percentile; T11b-high LUSC: Classical monocyte (minima=0.00035, median=0.32265, maxima=1, Q1 = 0.16193, Q3 = 0.52806)...
error-bars-defined.explanation: Caption explicitly defines box plot elements (25th-75th percentile, median, minima/maxima) for each group.

individual-data-points.explanation: GSEA enrichment plots are line plots of running enrichment score, not averaged data requiring individual points.

error-bars-defined.explanation: GSEA enrichment line plots show a single running score curve with NES/FDR/p values annotated; no error bars are present.

individual-data-points.explanation: Bar graph shows log2 fold-change values per gene from DEG analysis without individual data points or replicate values overlaid.

error-bars-defined.explanation: Bar graph of log2 fold change per gene has no error bars, only p-values annotated above each bar.

individual-data-points.explanation: Panel E consists of H&E and IHC micrographs, not a plot of averaged data.

error-bars-defined.explanation: Panel E is composed of micrographs, not a plot, so error bars do not apply.
